overview:
**Extreme fire danger holds today, driven by bone-dry fuels and single-digit humidity across the high country.**
- Extreme danger persists through Tuesday, easing to Very High by Aug 12–13 as humidity recovers late next week.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions are in effect on all BLM-administered public lands within Gunnison, Hinsdale, Montrose, Ouray, Saguache, and San Juan counties, with San Miguel County under countywide Stage 2 restrictions.
- Key drivers: ERC and BI both near record-high percentiles (98%/94%), min RH at 8%, and NNE winds around 10 mph.
- 4 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met today; no Red Flag Warning is posted, but a wildfire-smoke Air Quality Alert remains active for the region.
- Nearby fires: the Gold Mountain Fire two miles north of Ouray is 39,507 acres and 89% contained; the Elk Fire in the Gunnison/GMUG area is 2,911 acres and 40% contained, both with active fire behavior and area closures.
